name: SpliceKit Preferences Pane
description: Adds 'SpliceKit' and 'Debug' tabs to Final Cut Pro's Settings window. The SpliceKit tab holds feature toggles, FCP Defaults (transition warning, clip height, audio channel/pan defaults, spatial conform), and Timecode Bar Shortcuts checkboxes. The Debug tab reconstructs FCP's internal developer preferences (Apple strips its NIB from release builds). Survives SpliceKit patcher updates.
author: SpliceKit
